title: Halloween on Main
summary: Join us for a fun-filled day of family-friendly Halloween activities on October 25th on Main Street. There will be plenty of tricks and treats for everyone, including activities in Civic Square and inside 19 on the Park. Trick-or-treat along Main Street at participating businesses while supplies last!
description: Get ready for a spooktacular time at Halloween on Main! Join us for a fun-filled day of family-friendly Halloween activities on October 25th on Main Street. There will be plenty of tricks and treats for everyone, including activities in Civic Square and inside 19 on the Park. Trick-or-treat along Main Street at participating businesses while supplies last! Date: October 25th Time: 11 AM – 3 PM Location: Main Street, Stouffville Don’t miss out on this ghoulishly fun event! See you there in your costume, no matter the weather—rain or shine!
